description: Use hundreds of AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral and more through one OpenRouter account. Have a model write, answer or read pictures and PDFs, sort text and pull out data; make images, speech, transcripts and video; create embeddings and rank documents for search; run prompts in bulk at half price; and keep an eye on spending. Add a management key to see the account's credit and spending reports and to create API keys with their own limits.
